policy.conflict_rule: image evidence wins unless it violates a hard motion or validity constraint

hard_constraints: preserve joint frame axis type and limits
keep moving parent and child rigid groups separate
attach every physical interface member to its owning link
generate no solid for a virtual frame

advice.text: A visible clevis may use a hidden coaxial pin when the image-authored side plates already support that interpretation.
Prefer an explicit broad transition to an arbitrary shortest-path connector.
When the image shows a bilateral pair, generate one side and mirror it about the declared plane.
Do not expose a full bearing barrel when the image shows it enclosed by a housing.
